label: Principal
description: Represents the current claims-based application principal.

identities.description: Claims identities belonging to the principal.
Read-only snapshot of all identities. An anonymous principal has no identities.

identity.description: First identity, or null when the principal is anonymous.

isAuthenticated.description: Whether any identity has a non-empty authentication type.

x-identity:principal:changed.description: Emitted on the Bus when the effective principal changes.

hasClaim.description: Reports whether any identity contains the requested claim.

isInRole.description: Reports whether the principal has the .NET-compatible role claim.

setIdentities.description: Validates, defensively copies, and replaces all identities, setting status to authenticated or anonymous.

clear.description: Clears all identities and sets status to anonymous.

setInitializing.description: Clears all identities and marks server-session initialization as in progress.

setError.description: Clears all identities and marks server-session retrieval as failed.
